_comment: Friendbook rules. Every Facebook-specific value lives here or in theme.css / inject.js. Patterns are Java regexes matched (find, not full match) against PATH+QUERY, e.g. '/story.php?story_fbid=1&id=2'. Order of evaluation: friendsFeedUrl -> block -> allow -> default BLOCK. Escape backslashes twice in JSON.
_friendsFeedCanonical: Path+query patterns the friends-feed document may rewrite its own address to via history.replaceState (Facebook rewrites the feed URL to '/' after loading). Only tolerated inside a document that was loaded as friendsFeedUrl.
_desktopMode: true = start in desktop mode: desktopUserAgent, feed/login URLs moved to desktopHost, page laid out desktopViewportWidth CSS px wide and scaled to the screen. Can also be switched per session from the debug panel. The mobile site ignores filter=friends (serves Home); the desktop site honours it.
_desktopTextZoom: WebView text zoom (percent) in desktop mode; enlarges text only.
desktopUserAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/140.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
_login: While the session cookie is missing the app starts at loginUrl and allow/block rules are NOT enforced (Facebook moves the login form between /, /login/ and /unified/login_via/). Rules apply as soon as the cookie exists.
_openHosts: Internal hosts where every path is allowed (no path filtering).
_linkShim: Facebook's outbound-link redirector. The target in 'param' is opened in the system browser.
_resourceHosts: Sub-resource requests (images, scripts, XHR) to any other host are refused. Blocked hosts are logged in debug mode.
_injectOrigins: Origins where inject.js + theme.css are injected at document start.

hideLabels._sponsored: Feed units containing one of these labels (exact or with decoy letters, see sponsoredFuzzyRatio) are hidden.
hideLabels._sections: Blocks headed by one of these labels are hidden on every page.
sections: Get Facebook for Android and browse faster.
hideLabels._feedOnly: Like sections, but only applied on the friends feed (these words appear legitimately on profiles).

_autoFeedUnits: Detect feed units automatically (element with the most text+media children = feed list). Marked data-fbk-unit and treated like feedUnitSelectors.
_dumpLabels: Extra labels whose surroundings the debug panel's 'Dump page' logs (for writing selectors).
_adCtaLabels: Posts containing a button/link with exactly one of these texts are hidden as ads (the desktop feed draws its Ad label as SVG shapes with no text).
_sponsoredFuzzyMinLength: Labels shorter than this (e.g. "Ad") only match exactly.
_sponsoredHeaderPx: Sponsored labels only count within this many px of the top of a post (its header). 0 = anywhere.
_hideSideColumns: Hide every element laid out beside the feed (left nav, right rail).
_feedUnitSelectors: What counts as one post / feed unit.
_hideSelectors: Elements always hidden, grouped by reason (the group name shows up in data-fbk-hidden).
_nameSelectors: Inside a feed unit: elements styled as author names.
_timestampPattern: Short text matching this (case-insensitive JS regex) inside a feed unit is styled as a timestamp.
_forceLightMode: Classes swapped on <html> to force Facebook's light palette.
_headerLinks: url "@friendsFeedUrl" means the friendsFeedUrl value above; relative URLs resolve against the current host.
